correctness.rationale: The affine two-snapshot Galerkin Gram calculation has exact coefficients c_s=(t-y)K_s/[(t-s)Delta] and c_t=(y-s)K_t/[(t-s)Delta]. Strict Cauchy-Schwarz yields K_s,K_t>0 and SPD yields Delta>0. The exact diagonal 3D example produces reduced first coordinate -140484100/176978669 while all full-order coordinates are positive. Dimension-one/two minimality follows from 1D positive-scalar projection or exactness when two snapshots span the space. Standard-library exact verification executed 9250 rational identities.

value.rationale: For physically nonnegative snapshot solutions, a two-snapshot affine-SPD Galerkin surrogate inherits coordinatewise positivity on the entire training interval automatically. An exact cone membership criterion supplies a sharp parameter frontier and a positive full-order diagonal 3D counterexample shows extrapolation can fail; dimension three is minimal. These are actionable sign/structure statements beyond a routine norm-error bound; no claims are made for higher-rank or nonsymmetric reduction.
